verdict.rationale: Fly.io's evidence pack markets Machines/Sprites explicitly for long-running and agentic workloads (e.g., fly-io-docs-4, fly-io-docs-5, fly-io-docs-28) but never states any CPU or wall-clock execution time limit — Fly Machines are persistent VMs, not time-boxed functions, and no documentation here quantifies compute/runtime ceilings a devops-lead could compare against. Missing for 10: any documented CPU quota, timeout, or wall-clock limit per Machine/Sprite invocation, and any comparison table or pricing-limits doc addressing execution duration.
